future_interface: Terrain PCA latent may later be replaced by CART/world-model latent without changing the response-model selector logic.
interpretation_guard: TRAIN rough-context LOCO only. No validation/test/hard terrain is used. The global IQR is reporting scale only.

response_model.feature_map: [1, c, lambda, c outer lambda, quadratic lambda]
response_model.supervision_per_fold: 19 TRAIN contexts x 21 beta points = 399 physical response rows

selector: Predict all 21 beta responses, construct predicted Pareto reference, then minimize the same augmented weighted Tchebycheff objective for w.
terrain_encoder: strict fold-local PCA k95 from 17 rough TRAIN patches
